product.description: The Beelink GTi 14 Ultra is a compact mini PC built around the Intel Core Ultra 9 185H (16 cores / 22 threads, up to 5.10GHz) with an NPU rated up to 35 TOPS. It comes with 32GB DDR5-5600 memory and a 1TB NVMe SSD, with a second NVMe slot free for extra storage. Intel Arc graphics with 16GB shared memory handle everyday graphics, and the included eGPU dock lets you add a dedicated graphics card: NVIDIA RTX 4080 Super or AMD Radeon RX 7700 XT. The KSh 160,000 price is for the mini PC without a GPU; with the Radeon RX 7700 XT it is KSh 220,000. A fingerprint scanner is built into the power button, and it has built-in speakers, a Thunderbolt 4 port and dual 2.5G Ethernet.

faqs.question: Does it come with a graphics card?
faqs.answer: The KSh 160,000 price is for the mini PC without a dedicated GPU, and it uses Intel Arc graphics with 16GB shared memory. The eGPU dock is included, so you can add a graphics card. With the AMD Radeon RX 7700 XT the price is KSh 220,000.

faqs.question: Which graphics cards can I add?
faqs.answer: You can choose the AMD Radeon RX 7700 XT (12GB GDDR6, up to 250W TDP) or the NVIDIA RTX 4080 Super (16GB GDDR6X, up to 400W TDP). Message us on WhatsApp for the RTX 4080 Super price.

faqs.question: Can I add more storage?
faqs.answer: Yes. It ships with a 1TB NVMe SSD and has an extra NVMe slot free for a second drive.

faqs.question: What ports does it have?
faqs.answer: It has 5 × USB 3.0, 2 × USB Type-C, 1 × Thunderbolt 4, an SD card slot, 2 × 2.5G Ethernet, 1 × HDMI and 1 × DisplayPort.
